title: Charge Air Pressure Sensor Low Error
detail_of_failure: Low voltage is sensed in the pressure signal circuit of the charge (boost) pressure and temperature sensor.
controller_action: Operates with charge pressure as fixed value.
machine_effect: • Engine output is reduced. • Engine acceleration performance is unsatisfactory.
related_information: • Input voltage from the charge air pressure sensor (boost pressure sensor) can be checked with monitoring function. (Code: 36501 (V)) • Boost pressure by charge air pressure sensor (boost pressure sensor) can be checked with monitoring function. (Code: 36500 (kPa)) • After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Turn the starting switch to the ON position. • The connector of “socket” for troubleshooting for this sensor is female only. So the check for open circuit in the wiring harness and voltage check cannot be done (T-adapter is not provided). • When the sensor connector is disconnected, this failure code is shown.

steps.procedure: Check the wiring harness and connector. For details, see “Related Information to Troubleshooting”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”.

steps.cause: Defective power supply system of charge pressure sensor (boost pressure sensor)
steps.procedure: If failure code [CA187] or [CA227] is shown, do the troubleshooting for that code first.
1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors CAM SENSOR, FUEL RAIL PRESS, BOOST PRESS & IMT, and ECM. 3. Connect a T-adapter to the female side of ECM.

steps.cause: Ground fault in wiring harness (contact with GND circuit)
steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors ECM and BOOST PRESS & IMT, and connect T-adapter to female side of ECM.

If no failure is found by the above checks, it is possible that there is an open circuit in the wiring harness. See “Diagnose Open Circuit of Hydraulic Pressure Sensor System Wiring Harness” of “RELATED INFORMATION ON TROUBLESHOOTING”.

steps.cause: Defective boost pressure and temperature sensor (input voltage error in engine controller)
steps.procedure: If no failure is found by the checks on causes 1 to 5 and a failure is found by the checks on cause 6, the sensor is defective. 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Insert a T-adapter into the connector ECM. 3. Starting switch: ON

measurements.point: Between ECM (44) and Se (47) / nsor output

steps.procedure: If no failure is found by the previous checks, the engine controller is defective. (Because this is an internal defect, troubleshooting cannot be done.)
